## Details

<a id="music_pattern_base"></a>
### [`music_pattern_base`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L5) `$0F52-$0F53`

*variable*

Base address of the tune data; pattern offsets are added to it

- **Read by:** [`music_cmd_pattern`](music_driver.md#music_cmd_pattern)
- **Written by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_tune_bases"></a>
### [`music_tune_bases`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L17) `$0F54-$0F55`

*data*

Base address of the data of tune 0-4. Tune 0 is never started; its entries in these tables are placeholders.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_tune_pattern_tables"></a>
### [`music_tune_pattern_tables`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L21) `$0F5E-$0F5F`

*data*

Address of the pattern offset table of tune 0-4.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_tune_orders_v0"></a>
### [`music_tune_orders_v0`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L25) `$0F68-$0F69`

*data*

Order list of voice 0 for tune 0-4.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_instrument_ptrs"></a>
### [`music_instrument_ptrs`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L37) `$0F86-$0FB7`

*data*

Addresses of the 25 instrument records. Record: waveform; for pulse 5 bytes (width lo/hi, LFO flag, shift, LFO speed); AD, SR, slide step, octave offset, filter flag. Record, filter part (flag nonzero): mode, resonance, cutoff lo/hi, sweep slot ($80 none), sweep shift, sweep direction.

- **Read by:** [`music_set_instrument`](music_effects.md#music_set_instrument)

<a id="music_tune_volumes"></a>
### [`music_tune_volumes`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L46) `$0FB8-$0FBC`

*data*

Volume of tune 0-4 for SIGVOL.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_tune_tempos"></a>
### [`music_tune_tempos`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L49) `$0FBD-$0FC1`

*data*

Frames per tick of tune 0-4. Tune 0 has 0 (256 frames).

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_t1_order_v0"></a>
### [`music_t1_order_v0`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L52) `$0FC2-$0FCD`

*data*

Tune 1 voice 0 order list: P0 P0 P1 P1 P1 P1 repeat(to 19, 1 more time) P2 jump 0.

- **Entry of:** [`$0F6A-$0F71`](../../tables.md#table_0f6a)
